# Coding Guidelines

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### 1. Strict Domain Layer Boundary (ViewModels Never Access DAOs)

ViewModels and UI components must route all Room reads and writes through domain facades (`EventCoordinator.kt`, `EventReader.kt`, `DisplayEventRepository.kt`, `TasksOrgCoordinator.kt`) and never inject or call Room DAOs directly (`AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, verified across `HomeViewModel.kt` and `EventCoordinator.kt`).

### 2. Queue-Backed Sync Mutations (`PendingOperation`)

Every local create, update, delete, move, or RSVP on a synced calendar must execute inside a Room database transaction alongside an `EventWriter.queueOperation` call that records a `PendingOperation` row, before triggering an expedited WorkManager sync (`AGENTS.md`, `EventWriter.kt` lines 89-133, enforced by `PendingOperationTriggers.kt` and `EventWriter*Test`). Never fire-and-forget network writes from the UI or domain layer.

### 3. Fork Seam Isolation and Marker Comments

Keep fork features (`Tasks.org` integration, `Travel Time` alerts, and `Auto-Backup`) in dedicated packages (`data/tasks_org/`, `domain/tasks/`, `data/travel/`, `reminder/travel/`, `domain/backup/`). Every line or block added or modified in an upstream core file (`HomeViewModel.kt`, `HomeScreen.kt`, `MainActivity.kt`, `DisplayEventRepository.kt`, `DisplayEvent.kt`, `AgendaListModel.kt`, `AllDayStripLayout.kt`, `PlannerView.kt`, `MonthFullSpanLayout.kt`, `KashCalDatabase.kt`, `AndroidManifest.xml`) must carry a `// FORK:tasks-org`, `// FORK:travel-time`, `// FORK:tasks-widget`, `// FORK:auto-backup`, or `// FORK:fork-identity` comment, and `docs/fork/FORK_INTEGRATION.md` must stay updated (`AGENTS.md`, `docs/fork/FORK_INTEGRATION.md` §1–§4).

### 4. Tasks.org API v0 Encapsulation and Write Serialization

All column names, URIs, query parameter filters, and provider quirks for `content://org.tasks.api/v0` must go through `TasksOrgV0Mapper.kt` and `TasksOrgContract.kt`, with multi-table task saves built as pure `ContentProviderOperation` plans in `TasksOrgBatch.kt` and executed via a single atomic `ContentResolver.applyBatch` call (`docs/fork/FORK_FEATURES.md` §3.7, §10). All writes from `HomeViewModel.kt` must run on `Dispatchers.IO` serialized by `tasksOrgWriteMutex` (`docs/fork/FORK_FEATURES.md` §2).

### 5. Accessibility and String Resource Discipline

Never hardcode user-visible strings in Kotlin/Compose code; declare strings in `app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml` and update Portuguese translations (`values-pt/strings.xml` and `values-pt-rBR/strings.xml`) together via `app/src/fork/tools/gen_strings_pt.py` (`AGENTS.md`, `app/build.gradle.kts` lines 197-199). All interactive and image elements must provide accessibility labels — enforced by Android Lint in `app/build.gradle.kts` lines 204-205 (`error += "ContentDescription"`, `error += "ClickableViewAccessibility"`).

### 6. Compose Recomposition Stability and Static Analysis

External types used in Compose state (`java.time.*`, `android.net.Uri`) are registered as stable in `stability_config.conf` (wired in `app/build.gradle.kts` lines 14-16), and domain/UI lists use `kotlinx.collections.immutable.ImmutableList`/`ImmutableMap` (`DisplayEventRepository.kt` lines 5-8, 87). Security and code quality are verified via GitHub CodeQL (`.github/workflows/codeql.yml`, `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml`).

### 7. Credential and PII Log Redaction

Never store passwords or API tokens in Room (`Account.kt` line 48) and never log credentials, sync tokens, or unmasked email addresses (`AGENTS.md`). Store account credentials exclusively in `UnifiedCredentialManager.kt` (`EncryptedSharedPreferences`) and mask email addresses in logs via `maskEmail` (`CalDavSyncEngine.kt` line 27). Every new `PreferencesKeys` entry must be explicitly allow-listed or excluded in `ExportablePreferences` (`PreferencesKeys.kt` lines 13-15, enforced by `ExportablePreferencesTest`).

### 8. Deterministic UTC Unit Tests and KDoc Contracts

Unit tests in `:app` must pass under the pinned JVM flags `-Duser.timezone=UTC -Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US` (`app/build.gradle.kts` line 220) and `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` is a mandatory gate before completing any task (`AGENTS.md`). Comments and KDoc must state current invariants, RFC section references, and failure traps without historical narrative (`AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
